scene_description: Small black pedestal table in a corner next to a wall, holding a paperback book, a 1000-piece puzzle box, and an upright acrylic flyer stand.

targets.name: red paperback book
targets.description: Paperback book titled 'Strange Tastes' (red cover with flame imagery, yellow title text) lying flat and angled diagonally on the black pedestal surface, near the front-left edge, to the left of the blue Springbok puzzle box.
nearby_obstacles: Puzzle box to the right of the book
Upright acrylic flyer stand behind the book
targets.clearance_notes: Open space on the front and left sides toward the pedestal edge; book is only about 3 cm thick and lies flush on the surface, leaving little to grip from above or the sides.

candidate_improvements.description: Slide the book toward the front edge so that a strip along one side is exposed for grasping.
Stand the book upright on its spine or edge so a larger graspable surface is exposed.

targets.other_notes: Cover is glossy paperback; thin flat object.

targets.name: puzzle box
targets.description: Blue-and-red Springbok 1000-piece puzzle box (autumn red covered bridge on the lid, blue tape reading '2 missing pieces') lying flat and slightly skewed at the front-right of the black pedestal surface, close to the right edge, to the right of the red book.
nearby_obstacles: Book to the left of the box
targets.clearance_notes: Open space around the front and right sides, and the box is close to the pedestal edge so its sides are easily approached.
targets.other_notes: Box is large but shallow; blue tape on the lid is a visible identifier. Contents may shift when lifted.

targets.name: acrylic flyer stand
targets.description: Clear acrylic sign holder standing upright at the rear of the black pedestal surface, holding a gray 'LOVE PUZZLES? Join The Cozy Cornerpiece Club' flyer, behind and between the book and the puzzle box.
targets.clearance_notes: Open space on all sides; the book and box are in front of it but do not block access from the sides or rear.
targets.other_notes: Transparent, thin-walled acrylic with a small base footprint (about 6 cm deep), so it may be easy to tip.
